catalog.name: Reservoirs by Country
catalog.description: The Global Dam Watch (GDW) Database provides a comprehensive, harmonized collection of over 35,000 reservoir polygons worldwide. Developed by the Global Dam Watch consortium, this database combines existing repositories with new data collected through citizen science, remote sensing, and machine learning. It includes all types of anthropogenic instream barriers, with priority given to major dams forming reservoirs and run-of-river barriers on larger waterways. This dataset is split by country for focused analysis and faster loading times.

info.name: Attribution
info.content: Global Dam Watch Database developed by the Global Dam Watch consortium. Data compiled from multiple sources including citizen science, remote sensing, and machine learning approaches.

info.name: License
info.content: Open data under Creative Commons licensing. Please check individual data sources for specific terms and cite appropriately in publications.

info.name: Coverage
info.content: Over 35,000 reservoir polygons worldwide across 130+ countries, focusing on major dams and run-of-river barriers.
